mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/compression.md <<'EOF'
# Compression policy

The project's current recorded decision is to use zstd as the compression codec. It was chosen for its better compression ratio while keeping performance within requirements, accepting the trade-off of favoring compression efficiency over simplicity and ubiquity.
EOF
cat docs/policies/compression.md
